title: $C^0$-Poisson geometry, coisotropic submanifolds, and clean intersection points
summary: In this work, we initiate the study of rigidity and non-rigidity phenomena for Poisson homeomorphisms, defined as uniform $C^0$-limits of Poisson diffeomorphisms. First, we prove that Poisson homeomorphisms preserve the singular symplectic foliation: they map symplectic leaves to symplectic leaves by symplectic homeomorphisms. Second, we establish the $C^0$-rigidity of coisotropic submanifolds in Poisson manifolds.
